cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sunday's off again? Mum's made up the bed. You're telling her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed. I'll check when she's home; you make the call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write you an opening line, as usual. You're arranging the next visit with her, too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1/A3 treat work-related cancellation as recurrence; A5 names the habitual softening while helping and adds next-visit duty.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 shift explanation prompts overtime comparison; B4 softening request prompts as-usual help followed by added responsibility.

relationship.evidence: B4 fears Mum feeling unwanted and receives a usable opening line.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the task from one cancellation call to arranging the future relationship contact.

specificity.evidence: A1 made bed and A3 call timing support the practical consequences.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 as-usual phrase identifies the repeated burden inside a real offer, avoiding a detached pattern speech.
